messages:
julian_acme: Hey team — procurement at Acme Pharma says they will not accept an invoice unless we put their ERP PO into our invoice record using their exact PO template and include their EORI/VAT identifiers. They flagged missing fields in the sample we sent: vendor_code, cost_center, line_level_vat_rate, and EORI number. Can we hold billing until they upload the PO?

maria_support: Ack. Do they need us to re-issue the invoice or just attach the PO to the billing record? Any example of their template? :thinking_face: 

julian_acme: They attached a sample XML PO in their ticket (they prefer XML). They said their AP system will reject anything that isn't using their <BuyerPO> schema. Quote from procurement: "Invoice must reference PO.id, PO.vendorCode, PO.eori, and each line must have VATRate."

tim_billing: We can withhold invoicing until PO arrives. If they want a new invoice generated with their fields, we'll need to map our invoice fields -> their PO fields. Small checklist: 1) verify vendor_code matches our vendor registry 2) include EORI (EU import) if present 3) line-level VAT rates 4) attach PO PDF/XML to the billing record.

anna_finance: FYI — if they require EORI on invoice we need customer's EORI (they provided it), and we must include it on the invoice header. Also need confirmation whether they want net vs gross pricing shown per-line for VAT reconciliation.

maria_support: Can you paste their XML sample here? I can ask eng to add mapping if it's a simple rename mapping.

julian_acme: Pasted below (redacted vendor token):
```xml
<BuyerPO>
  <id>PO-2026-7789</id>
  <vendorCode>ACME-ERP-099</vendorCode>
  <eori>EU123456789000</eori>
  <lines>
    <line>
      <sku>REDWOOD-API-HOUR</sku>
      <quantity>100</quantity>
      <unitPrice>0.50</unitPrice>
      <VATRate>20</VATRate>
    </line>
  </lines>
</BuyerPO>
```

tim_billing: Perfect. Mapping looks straightforward: our invoice.number -> BuyerPO.id, our vendor_code field -> vendorCode, add custom meta eori -> eori, and set per-line VATRate to the line.vat_percent we store. I'll create a proforma that matches their schema and hold final invoice until they confirm.

maria_support: Quick operational note: procurement also asked that the invoice not be issued until PO is uploaded into their Coupa/SAP system AND we've confirmed vendor registration. They may refuse email PDFs.

anna_finance: Escalating to sales for signed quote confirmation (we need authorization to bind price after mapping). @tim_billing can you prepare a proforma marked "Pending PO - Do not charge" and include the XML attachment? I can approve hold policy for this customer.

tim_billing: Will do. Draft proforma created and attached to ticket. Left comment: "Hold for customer PO upload and EORI confirmation."

maria_support: I pinged procurement contact and asked for their ERP upload confirmation and any required vendor registration form (W-8/W-9 equivalent for EU).

deploy-bot: [notification] proforma-2467890123.pdf uploaded to ticket #5421 by tim_billing at 2026-04-12T12:32:00Z

julian_acme: Received, thanks. Procurement will attempt to upload PO this afternoon. If it still rejects, I'll send the error message.

maria_support: Great — we'll keep invoice in pending state. If procurement provides the rejection XML, please paste it here, even a short error string helps (e.g., "missing: BuyerPO.eori").

anna_finance: Next steps for internal ops: once we get their PO upload success or rejection message, finance will either finalize invoice or continue hold. Tagging as escalation -> finance/sales liaison.

maria_support: Noted. Closing loop when we have the upload confirmation or their rejection XML. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
